Fri, 07/31/2026 - 04:48pm
The Board of Elections absentee meeting scheduled for Tuesday, August 4th, 2026 has been cancelled. The next meeting is scheduled for Tuesday, September 1st, 2026 at 5:00 pm. Please call the Board of Elections Office at 252-946-2321 for more information.
